task_name: Apexguard - Product label and dealer collateral system
client_brief:
Dealer-ready roll labels and bay imagery for Apexguard

Our dealer meetings need a reliable label system, not another set of labels assembled one by one. Apexguard has three tiers that should read as one family, and the current stock export must control the product information.

The commission

 Product roll label: 13 named exports. The tier is identified accurately. The required installation copy fits at label size.

 Dealer range brochure: 1 named export. The product tiers are easy to compare. The uses are supported by the approved range data.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Paint protection film, window tint and ceramic coating supplied to dealer groups and to independent installers who buy film by the roll.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Charlotte, North Carolina; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Apexguard Surface Systems is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Charlotte, North Carolina, and this commission covers phase 2: dealer labels and channel collateral.
brand_identity.audience: Dealer group principals and fixed operations managers aged 35 to 55 deciding whether to put us on their reconditioning line, and independent installer owners aged 28 to 50 who buy film by the roll and post their own work. Behind both sits a vehicle owner aged 30 to 55 protecting a sixty thousand dollar car.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Full PPF installs 1,800 to 6,000 dollars, tint packages 400 to 1,200 dollars, film by the roll to installers 900 to 4,200 dollars. Premium performance tier, well above discount tint shops and deliberately not tuner.
brand_identity.typography: A single near technical system: a tight modern grotesque for the mark, headings and tier names set in confident spacing, paired with a clean humanist sans for spec tables and body so performance numbers read as data. No display flourish, no italic drama.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, exact, performance led. States numbers and lets them carry. Example line the brand would write: Ten year warranty, self healing topcoat, 92 percent clarity retained. No exclamation points, no percentage flashes, no hype.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The rebrand mark was drafted for us by an earlier round and no working file survives. What we hold is a flat raster export of the drafted master mark and a phone photograph of the installer shop card that was printed from an earlier revision of it. The mark has to be recovered as real artwork before the rollout can carry it, and the three tier marks brought alongside so the family reads as one.
brand_identity.values: Performance stated honestly and warranted as written. One brand across every surface, from the top of a dealer deck to the end of a film box.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

assets.description: Transparent, tightly bounded Adobe-vectorized shield-and-wordmark master cleaned from the supplied artwork.
1600 px transparent raster companion for placement and preview.
White vector variant for approved dark-ground use.
